about: Shared good/bad examples for the form rules (US-108). Read by backend/tests/unit/test_form_rules.py and frontend/src/lib/formRules.test.ts. `schema` is GET /form-schema as the code serves it today (a test fails when it drifts); `today` is the Singapore date the date rules run against unless a case sets its own.
